FAQ

Who do you work with?

First-time and established authors, from early drafts to published titles.

Are interviews written or live?

Most interviews are written and sent by email, so you can respond whenever it suits you. If you would rather do a voice or video interview, just say so and we will arrange it.

How does a consultation work?

You share your goals and manuscript status, and we outline a clear plan together.

How long does a typical engagement last?

It depends on the scope. Details are agreed during the consultation.

Can you help with a book that is already published?

Yes. Repositioning and rebranding existing titles is a common request.

Who Is Behind This Website

This website is led by Michael Raphael Daniel, who also goes by Miraph Dan, a short name chosen for professional use. Michael Raphael Daniel is the real person behind every name you see across our platforms, and he is the one to hold accountable for the work.

Here is how everything connects:

  • U. Rex Michael is the featuring brand. This website is its home: where authors and their books are showcased, and where consultations begin.
  • Ink House is the marketing team. It handles outreach and enquiries for U. Rex Michael, which is why our official email address carries the Ink House name.
  • Miraph Dan is the personal name you will meet in correspondence and across our channels.

One person, one standard: every enquiry is answered under the same leadership, and every engagement is overseen directly by the founder.
